name: HWR_IMAGE

columns.name: IMAGE_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the image table.

columns.name: MIME_TYPE
columns.description: mime type of the image file i.e. jpeg

columns.name: BO_TYPE
columns.description: This is the type of the business object - goal, team or contest.

columns.name: BO_ID
columns.description: This is the id of the business object - goal, team or contest

columns.name: IMAGE_DATA
columns.description: This is the image that each business object is associated with.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
